name: BankBridge
description: Hosted, read-only MCP server for your own US bank, credit card, and brokerage accounts at https://bankbridge.money/api/mcp: balances, transactions, spending summaries, recurring charges, monthly cashflow, and investment holdings, fetched live with nothing stored. author: Great Work LLC
